text:
REVIEW UPDATE!!
- The doctor must be skilled, judging from the pictures I took.
Without even examining the patient's skin, he just said it was roseola.
After taking medication for about two or three days, the rash improved.
- Other people with good reviews might have had their treatment plans explained by the doctor. In my case, the doctor didn't explain anything, and I was left confused with the nurse, which I found irritating. However, I'm adding a star because the diagnosis seems correct.

—————————————

I came to this clinic based solely on previous reviews.
Everyone said the doctor was attentive.

And explained everything thoroughly.

My personal experience:
- The doctor didn't explain anything; I was the one asking most of the questions. It felt awkward, like I kept asking questions and wondering when I would leave.
- He didn't explain the treatment method. I had to ask the nurse outside when I went to get the medication.
- The doctor judged the rash from the pictures, without even looking at my actual skin. He might be very skilled, though.
- The nurse answered in a typical nurse-like way, which wasn't detailed.
- I had roseola, which the doctor said was likely caused by a virus, but it should have cleared up, leaving a mark on my skin. I thought it wouldn't be serious. I was prescribed two types of oral medication for three weeks. There are tons of topical medications too. The cost of the medicine is almost 4000 baht.
- I don't know the treatment plan, so I don't know which medications to refuse. I feel very uncomfortable with this shocking price for the first treatment, and they have another appointment in three weeks.

Anyone considering this clinic should think carefully. Most importantly, prepare a lot of money and make an appointment in advance because there are a lot of patients. I've seen other people pay 3000-3000 baht as normal, but I'm really confused about this.
